verdict.rationale: Phone support is a fair channel question for an AI customer-support agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only mentions ticketing systems (Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, Pylon), email, live chat, Slack, and a generic API channel, with nothing on speech-to-text, text-to-speech, or telephony. The API reuses the same configurations, but nothing shows it supports voice calls.
